mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_reconciliation_batch (batch_no, business_date, channel_code, bill_source, status) VALUES (#{batchNo}, #{businessDate}, #{channelCode}, #{billSource}, 'CREATED')
mapper.select: SELECT batch_no, business_date, channel_code, bill_source, status, channel_count, internal_count, matched_count, difference_count, readiness_status, readiness_summary, readiness_suggested_action, readiness_blocking_owner, readiness_chain_count, readiness_completed_chain_count, readiness_abnormal_chain_count, readiness_pending_chain_count, readiness_checked_at FROM t_reconciliation_batch WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo}

SELECT batch_no, business_date, channel_code, bill_source, status, channel_count, internal_count, matched_count, difference_count, readiness_status, readiness_summary, readiness_suggested_action, readiness_blocking_owner, readiness_chain_count, readiness_completed_chain_count, readiness_abnormal_chain_count, readiness_pending_chain_count, readiness_checked_at FROM t_reconciliation_batch ORDER BY business_date DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_reconciliation_channel_record (batch_no, channel_trade_no, payment_order_id, amount, trade_status, trade_time) VALUES (#{batchNo}, #{record.channelTradeNo}, #{record.paymentOrderId}, #{record.amount}, #{record.tradeStatus}, #{record.tradeTime})

INSERT INTO t_reconciliation_internal_record (batch_no, payment_order_id, amount, internal_status, source_system, paid_time) VALUES (#{batchNo}, #{record.paymentOrderId}, #{record.amount}, #{record.internalStatus}, #{record.sourceSystem}, #{record.paidTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_no, channel_trade_no, payment_order_id, amount, trade_status, trade_time FROM t_reconciliation_channel_record WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo}
SELECT id, batch_no, payment_order_id, amount, internal_status, source_system, paid_time FROM t_reconciliation_internal_record WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo}
SELECT channel_trade_no, payment_order_id, amount, trade_status, trade_time FROM t_reconciliation_channel_record WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo} ORDER BY trade_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT payment_order_id, amount, internal_status, source_system, paid_time FROM t_reconciliation_internal_record WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo} ORDER BY paid_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_reconciliation_difference (difference_no, batch_no, difference_type, payment_order_id, channel_amount, internal_amount, status) VALUES (#{differenceNo}, #{batchNo}, #{differenceType}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{channelAmount}, #{internalAmount}, 'OPEN')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_reconciliation_batch SET status = 'COMPLETED', channel_count = #{channelCount}, internal_count = #{internalCount}, matched_count = #{matchedCount}, difference_count = #{differenceCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo}

UPDATE t_reconciliation_batch SET readiness_status = #{readinessStatus}, readiness_summary = #{readinessSummary}, readiness_suggested_action = #{readinessSuggestedAction}, readiness_blocking_owner = #{readinessBlockingOwner}, readiness_chain_count = #{readinessChainCount}, readiness_completed_chain_count = #{readinessCompletedChainCount}, readiness_abnormal_chain_count = #{readinessAbnormalChainCount}, readiness_pending_chain_count = #{readinessPendingChainCount}, readiness_checked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo}
mapper.select: SELECT difference_no, batch_no, difference_type, payment_order_id, channel_amount, internal_amount, status, resolution, remark, detected_at, resolved_at FROM t_reconciliation_difference WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo} ORDER BY detected_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_reconciliation_difference SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolution = #{resolution}, remark = #{remark}, resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE difference_no = #{differenceNo} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_reconciliation_batch) AS batch_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_reconciliation_batch WHERE status = 'RUNNING') AS running_batch_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_reconciliation_difference WHERE status = 'OPEN') AS open_difference_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(matched_count), 0) FROM t_reconciliation_batch) AS matched_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_cross_system_fact_snapshot (business_chain_id, system_code, fact_type, fact_no, business_no, fact_status, amount, snapshot_version, occurred_at, payload) VALUES (#{businessChainId}, #{systemCode}, #{factType}, #{factNo}, #{businessNo}, #{factStatus}, #{amount}, #{snapshotVersion}, #{occurredAt}, #{payload}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fact_status = VALUES(fact_status), amount = VALUES(amount), snapshot_version = VALUES(snapshot_version), occurred_at = VALUES(occurred_at), payload = VALUES(payload)
mapper.select: SELECT business_chain_id, system_code, fact_type, fact_no, business_no, fact_status, amount, snapshot_version, occurred_at, payload, created_at FROM t_cross_system_fact_snapshot WHERE business_chain_id = #{businessChainId} ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, id ASC
